{{Conjecture|legends}}
A notorious '''pirate captain''' had been carousing on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. While he was distracted, a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] bypassed security of his [[Unidentified pirate captain's ship|ship's]] [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]]. Having secured the data that revealed the pirates' home base, the slicer wiped it clean to ensure that the authorities would be able to reach it first.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Pirate Partygoers}}</ref>
